g.text: Frame and four real coped braces · coordinates, preparation and cut record
C2.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY DESIGN — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
Coped to front leg and rear post outer faces.
Coped to rear posts / middle rail; apex miterY32.
Axial envelope is not saw length.
BRACE PREPARATION · SAME PHYSICAL SOLIDS AS STEP
BZ1 | final axial envelope18.749736in | cope contacts: FRONT-LEG1, REAR-LEG1
BZ2 | final axial envelope18.749736in | cope contacts: FRONT-LEG2, REAR-LEG2
BV1 | final axial envelope15.659456in | cope contacts: REAR-LEG1, SEAT-REAR2
BV2 | final axial envelope15.659456in | cope contacts: REAR-LEG2, SEAT-REAR2
Dry fit exact stock into fixture at listed workpoints.
No square-cut shop length substitutes for these copes.
Retain pan and through-tube sleeve dimensions from C2.
Weld gap,throat,sequence and local HSSwall checks open.
All brace parts are exact hollow CAD solids; profiles are trimmed by the nominal rounded outer faces of their receiving tubes.
Workpoint dimensions describe assembly geometry. Final coped lengths depend on actual tube corner radii,root gaps and fit-up.
Preliminary stiffness analysis does not qualify the connection welds,HSSwall strength,buckling,fatigue or passenger load certification.
No brace enters the cushion or projects beyond the existing seat/foot envelope. Pinch/entrapment and passenger leg-clearance validation remain open.
